title: Implement exponential backoff retry calculation
prompt: Implement the `delay_for_attempt` method on `ExponentialBackoff` in `src/lib.rs`. For attempt 0, it should return 0. For attempts between 1 and max_retries, it should return initial_delay_ms * (factor ^ (attempt - 1)) truncated to u64 and capped at max_delay_ms. For attempts exceeding max_retries, it should return max_delay_ms. Ensure all tests in `tests/test_backoff.rs` pass.
acceptance: All unit tests in tests/test_backoff.rs pass cleanly
